name: Bumper Bridge
source: Starfinder Society Scenario #1-04: The Great Absalom Relay
description: The bumpers on the bridge push forward, attempting to knock competitors into the river.
disable: DC 16 Thievery (trained) to shut off the mechanisms
routine: (3 actions) The bumper bridge attempts to Shove all creatures on the bridge into the river with an Athletics bonus of +9 (no multiple attack penalty).

defensiveAbilities.name: Into the Drink!
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature ends its movement on the bridge

Effect The bumper bridge attempts to Shove that creature into the river with an Athletics bonus of +9. If the triggering creature was not aware of this hazard, they take a –2 circumstance penalty to their Fortitude DC. The bumper bridge then rolls initiative.
